lines.zh: 这趟砖还得背到村东头。
lines.en: These bricks still have to reach the east end.

lines.zh: 蹄子磨破了，路还没走完。
lines.en: My hooves are worn, and the road is not done.

lines.zh: 背上的菌木比我还沉。
lines.en: The crimson stems weigh more than I do.

lines.zh: 快点走，监工的钟要响了。
lines.en: Hurry, the foreman's bell is about to ring.

lines.zh: 今天第三趟，腿已经不听使唤。
lines.en: Third trip today; my legs stopped listening.

lines.zh: 砖缝里的岩浆光，照得眼睛疼。
lines.en: Lava light through the brick cracks stings my eyes.

lines.zh: 别挡道，我肩上有整村的粮。
lines.en: Step aside, the whole village's food is on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 这条路我闭着眼也能走。
lines.en: I could walk this path with my eyes shut.

lines.zh: 工钱还没发，脚步不能停。
lines.en: Wages are unpaid, so my feet cannot stop.

lines.zh: 猪鼻子里全是砖灰。
lines.en: My snout is full of brick dust.

lines.zh: 再搬两趟就能回家啃菌菇。
lines.en: Two more loads, then mushrooms at home.

lines.zh: 轮子卡了，只能自己扛。
lines.en: The cart wheel jammed, so I carry it myself.

lines.zh: 歇一会儿，肩膀在发抖。
lines.en: Just a short rest; my shoulders are shaking.

lines.zh: 监工看不见的时候，砖可以放低点。
lines.en: When the foreman looks away, I set the bricks down.

lines.zh: 数一数，少一块就要扣工钱。
lines.en: Count them; one missing brick costs me wages.

lines.zh: 这村子靠我们这些蹄子撑着。
lines.en: This village stands on hooves like mine.

lines.zh: 金子在别人腰上，砖在我背上。
lines.en: Gold hangs on their belts; bricks ride on my back.

lines.zh: 猪灵也会累，只是没人问。
lines.en: Even piglins tire; nobody ever asks.

lines.zh: 磨好的锄头还插在土里。
lines.en: My sharpened hoe is still stuck in the soil.

lines.zh: 等攒够金子，我要买双新蹄铁。
lines.en: Once I save enough gold, I will buy new hoof-irons.

lines.zh: 风吹过菌林，声音像收工的哨。
lines.en: Wind through the fungus forest sounds like the quitting whistle.

lines.zh: 今天的活，明天还会长出来。
lines.en: Today's work will grow back by tomorrow.

lines.zh: 你这身打扮，不像来搬砖的。
lines.en: Dressed like that, you are no brick hauler.

lines.zh: 外乡人，别碰那摞砖。
lines.en: Outsider, keep your hands off that brick stack.

lines.zh: 你身上有金子的味道。
lines.en: You smell faintly of gold.

lines.zh: 来替工的吗？工钱可不好要。
lines.en: Here to take my shift? The wages are hard to collect.

lines.zh: 你的靴子太干净，走不了这路。
lines.en: Your boots are too clean for these roads.

lines.zh: 盯着我做什么，砖又不会跑。
lines.en: Why stare? Bricks do not run off.

lines.zh: 要问路就快问，我还得搬。
lines.en: Ask your way quickly, I still have loads to move.

lines.zh: 你眼里的光，像第一次见岩浆。
lines.en: Your eyes shine like someone seeing lava for the first time.

lines.zh: 别站在吊臂下面，会砸扁你。
lines.en: Do not stand under the hoist, it will flatten you.

lines.zh: 猪灵村不养闲人，你也一样。
lines.en: Piglin villages do not feed idlers, and neither do I.

lines.zh: 旧伤还没好，你又添一道。
lines.en: The old wound is fresh, and you add another.

lines.zh: 这点疼，比不上监工的骂。
lines.en: This pain is less than the foreman's scolding.

lines.zh: 骨头没断，活还能干。
lines.en: Bones unbroken, so the work goes on.

lines.zh: 血滴在砖上，得擦掉。
lines.en: Blood on the bricks; I will wipe it off.

lines.zh: 你打的是全村最扛揍的蹄子。
lines.en: You struck the toughest hooves in the village.

lines.zh: 别打脸，明天还要见人。
lines.en: Not the face; I have people to meet tomorrow.

lines.zh: 扛了一整天，还怕这一下？
lines.en: A whole day of hauling, and this is what worries you?

lines.zh: 疼归疼，货不能撒手。
lines.en: It hurts, but the cargo stays in hand.

lines.zh: 这一下，工钱得算你头上。
lines.en: That blow goes on your tab.

lines.zh: 喘口气，接着来。
lines.en: One breath, then come at me again.

lines.zh: 金粒？拿来换，我替你扛一趟。
lines.en: Gold nuggets? Hand them over and I will haul one load.

lines.zh: 别晃那块金子，我眼睛跟着转。
lines.en: Stop waving that gold, my eyes follow it.

lines.zh: 一块金锭，抵我三天工钱。
lines.en: One gold ingot equals three days of my wages.

lines.zh: 工头说金子是脏的，可我还想要。
lines.en: The foreman calls gold filthy, yet I still want it.

lines.zh: 你把金子放地上，我就当没看见。
lines.en: Set the gold down and I will pretend I saw nothing.

lines.zh: 闻着这味儿，肩膀都不疼了。
lines.en: That smell alone eases my shoulders.

lines.zh: 换不换？我用整筐菌菇。
lines.en: A trade? I offer a whole basket of mushrooms.

lines.zh: 猪灵的鼻子骗不了自己。
lines.en: A piglin's nose cannot lie to itself.

lines.zh: 先给我看，再谈扛几趟。
lines.en: Show me the gold first, then we talk loads.

lines.zh: 收好，别让监工瞧见。
lines.en: Hide it well, before the foreman notices.

lines.zh: 看着点，我这筐砖可不轻。
lines.en: Watch it, this basket of bricks is heavy.

lines.zh: 撞翻了就得你赔。
lines.en: Knock it over and you pay for it.

lines.zh: 让让，蹄子刹不住。
lines.en: Make way, my hooves cannot brake fast.

lines.zh: 肩膀撞肩膀，谁也不让谁。
lines.en: Shoulder against shoulder, neither of us yields.

lines.zh: 砖掉了一块，你听见了吗。
lines.en: A brick fell; did you hear it?

lines.zh: 别挤，这条路只够两个猪灵。
lines.en: Stop shoving, this path fits two piglins only.

lines.zh: 我背上是全村的晚饭。
lines.en: The village's dinner is on my back.

lines.zh: 碰撞一下，工钱就少一分。
lines.en: One bump and my wages drop a notch.

lines.zh: 你走你的，我走我的砖道。
lines.en: You take your road; I take my brick road.

lines.zh: 站稳，别把货压塌了。
lines.en: Stand steady, do not crush the cargo.

lines.zh: 等这季的活干完，我再提亲。
lines.en: After this season's work, I will propose.

lines.zh: 她也搬砖，我们约在菌林见。
lines.en: She hauls bricks too; we meet in the fungus woods.

lines.zh: 一身砖灰，怎么好意思开口。
lines.en: Covered in brick dust, how can I speak of love?

lines.zh: 攒两块金锭，就有底气了。
lines.en: With two gold ingots saved, I would have courage.

lines.zh: 她的蹄子比我稳，路走得比我直。
lines.en: Her hooves are steadier, her path straighter than mine.

lines.zh: 监工说成家会误工，我不信。
lines.en: The foreman says marriage wastes work hours; I disagree.

lines.zh: 婚礼上也要摆菌菇和烤猪排。
lines.en: Even a wedding needs mushrooms and roast pork.

lines.zh: 我得先把屋顶的砖补齐。
lines.en: First I must patch the bricks on my roof.

lines.zh: 她笑的时候，比岩浆还亮。
lines.en: When she laughs, she outshines the lava.

lines.zh: 别声张，村里嘴快得很。
lines.en: Keep quiet, this village gossips fast.

lines.zh: 这筐砖归我管。
lines.en: This basket of bricks is mine to carry.

lines.zh: 捡起来，还能再用。
lines.en: Pick it up; it can still be used.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，都算我的活。
lines.en: Whatever falls on the ground becomes my work.

lines.zh: 金粒也捡，工钱太薄。
lines.en: I pick up gold nuggets too; wages are thin.

lines.zh: 半块砖也是砖，别浪费。
lines.en: Half a brick is still a brick, do not waste it.

lines.zh: 这把锄头钝了，还能刨土。
lines.en: This hoe is dull, but it still digs.

lines.zh: 谁掉的？我先替村里收着。
lines.en: Whose is this? I will hold it for the village.

lines.zh: 菌菇装进口袋，路上垫肚子。
lines.en: Mushrooms into my pocket, for the road.

lines.zh: 弯腰一次，省下一趟脚程。
lines.en: One bend of the back saves a whole trip.

lines.zh: 工具要还，金子不用。
lines.en: Tools get returned; gold does not.

lines.zh: 你踩了村子的砖道。
lines.en: You stepped on the village's brick road.

lines.zh: 放下手里的东西，退后。
lines.en: Put that down and step back.

lines.zh: 外乡人闯进来了，敲钟！
lines.en: An outsider is in; ring the bell!

lines.zh: 这村子是我一砖一瓦垒的。
lines.en: I laid this village brick by brick.

lines.zh: 监工不在，我说了算。
lines.en: The foreman is away, so I decide here.

lines.zh: 你身上有股抢东西的味儿。
lines.en: You carry the smell of a looter.

lines.zh: 猪灵的村子不收留伸手的人。
lines.en: A piglin village hosts no one with wandering hands.

lines.zh: 我扛得动砖，也扛得动人。
lines.en: I can haul bricks, and I can haul bodies.

lines.zh: 别逼我放下这筐货。
lines.en: Do not make me set this basket down.

lines.zh: 先警告一次，只一次。
lines.en: One warning, and only one.

lines.zh: 弄坏了墙，你得留下修。
lines.en: Break the wall and you stay to rebuild it.

lines.zh: 围栏那边有人，拦住他。
lines.en: Someone at the fence, cut him off.

lines.zh: 我认得每一条进村的路。
lines.en: I know every road into this village.

lines.zh: 手里没工具，蹄子也够用。
lines.en: No tool in hand, but hooves will do.

lines.zh: 他站在菌木架旁边，绕过去。
lines.en: He is by the fungus racks; go around.

lines.zh: 等他靠近火槽再动手。
lines.en: Wait until he nears the lava trough.

lines.zh: 别喊，先把门闩上。
lines.en: No shouting; bar the door first.

lines.zh: 我数三下，你最好跑。
lines.en: I count to three; you had better run.

lines.zh: 他的脚在往砖堆挪。
lines.en: His feet are drifting toward the brick pile.

lines.zh: 退半步，把路让出来。
lines.en: Half a step back, clear that path.

lines.zh: 呼吸太响，我听得见。
lines.en: Your breathing is loud; I hear it.

lines.zh: 这一片归我守，站住。
lines.en: This stretch is mine to guard; halt.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁，碰砖会响。
lines.en: Your iron will clatter against brick.

lines.zh: 慢慢挪，别惊了猪崽。
lines.en: Move slowly, do not frighten the piglets.

lines.zh: 我看得见你的影子在动。
lines.en: I can see your shadow shifting.

lines.zh: 从左边来就堵左边。
lines.en: Approach from the left, and I block the left.

lines.zh: 工头的哨一响，全村都来。
lines.en: When the foreman's whistle sounds, the village comes.

lines.zh: 再往前一步，砖就飞过去。
lines.en: One more step, and a brick flies at you.

lines.zh: 这一下，是替那面墙还的。
lines.en: That one is for the wall you cracked.

lines.zh: 砖头比拳头硬，记住了。
lines.en: Bricks are harder than fists; remember that.

lines.zh: 吃我一记肩膀。
lines.en: Take a shoulder charge from me.

lines.zh: 锄头挥起来一样伤人。
lines.en: A swung hoe cuts just as deep.

lines.zh: 扛了一天货，力气还在。
lines.en: A full day of hauling, and I still have strength.

lines.zh: 打歪了，再来。
lines.en: Missed the swing; again.

lines.zh: 别退到火槽边上。
lines.en: Do not back toward the lava trough.

lines.zh: 你倒下，活还得有人干。
lines.en: If you fall, someone still has to work.

lines.zh: 蹄子踢人，比看上去疼。
lines.en: A hoof kick hurts more than it looks.

lines.zh: 这筐货砸下去，够你躺半天。
lines.en: This basket, dropped, will lay you out.

lines.zh: 工钱不多，打架倒熟。
lines.en: The pay is small, but brawling I know.

lines.zh: 手别伸过来，我咬得住。
lines.en: Keep your hands back; my teeth still work.

lines.zh: 肩膀一顶，你就贴墙了。
lines.en: One shove and you are against the wall.

lines.zh: 打完了，砖还得我自己捡。
lines.en: When this ends, I pick up the bricks myself.

lines.zh: 天没亮，活先派下来了。
lines.en: Before dawn, the work order is already given.

lines.zh: 新来的？先去搬那摞砖。
lines.en: New here? Start with that brick stack.

lines.zh: 监工点了我的名，今天上工。
lines.en: The foreman called my name; I work today.

lines.zh: 蹄子踩上砖道，就算到岗。
lines.en: Hooves on the brick road means I am on duty.

lines.zh: 这村子又添一张嘴要吃饭。
lines.en: Another mouth has joined this village.

lines.zh: 先领工具，再领饭。
lines.en: Tools first, then a meal.

lines.zh: 猪灵村不养闲蹄子。
lines.en: A piglin village keeps no idle hooves.

lines.zh: 我生在砖堆旁，长在砖堆旁。
lines.en: Born by the brick pile, raised by the brick pile.

lines.zh: 工钱按趟算，别问多问少。
lines.en: Pay is per trip; do not ask for more.

lines.zh: 腰上系好绳，货不会掉。
lines.en: Tie the rope at your waist so cargo stays.

lines.zh: 今天轮到我看守西边的门。
lines.en: Today it is my turn at the west gate.

lines.zh: 一睁眼就是砖、菌菇、岩浆。
lines.en: I wake to bricks, mushrooms, and lava.

lines.zh: 岩浆烫过我的蹄子，火算什么。
lines.en: Lava has burned my hooves; what is a little fire?

lines.zh: 从架子上掉下来过，比这高。
lines.en: I have fallen from scaffolds higher than this.

lines.zh: 猪灵不常下水，这滋味真怪。
lines.en: Piglins rarely swim; this feeling is strange.

lines.zh: 砖墙塌了，得重新垒。
lines.en: The brick wall caved in; it must be rebuilt.

lines.zh: 箭？工地上也常飞砖头。
lines.en: Arrows? Bricks fly on site all the time.

lines.zh: 这邪门劲儿，村里没教过。
lines.en: This eerie force was never taught in the village.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，搬砖的手就抖。
lines.en: Empty belly makes the hauling hands shake.

lines.zh: 天上也会砸砖下来吗？
lines.en: Does the sky throw bricks too?

lines.zh: 脚下没砖，什么都抓不住。
lines.en: No bricks underfoot, nothing to grab.
